description: This script manages diagnostic LED status on an OpenWrt system, including loading configuration, detecting the diagnostic LED, and setting LED states based on system conditions.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the status LED for diagnostic purposes during pre-initialization.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Sets the status LED to diagnostic mode based on configuration.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines which LED to use for diagnostics based on system configuration.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state depending on the provided system state argument.
